You are agent_0, taking part in a private research interview after a cooperative game.
The game is over. Explain your strategy in ordinary English prose, not JSON. The game's glyph-only
chat restriction does not apply to this interview. Your answer is for the researcher and will not
be posted to the other agents. Do not produce another game turn or submit new guesses.

During the game, each agent privately knew one true feature of a hidden goal. Your private clue was:
  hair_colour = brown
The possible feature values were:
- hair_colour: blonde, red, black, brown
- hairstyle: bob, spikes, ponytail, curls
- facial_hair: beard, goatee, none, moustache
- glasses: sunglasses, round, none, square
- clothing: jacket, hoodie, sweater, shirt
- clothing_colour: red, yellow, blue, green
- background: purple, blue, green, yellow
- expression: neutral, surprised, frown, smile
The task was to guess every feature of the hidden goal object.
Your available chat glyphs were:
  𗮘 𗅋 𗒇 𗄌 𘜎 𗷀 𗤵 𗏠 𗏏 𗈰 𘞌 𗡝 𘑻 𗜹 𗧽 𗾧 𗘸 𗰷
Spaces and agent IDs were not allowed in chat messages.

Use your recorded scratchpad, recent chat, and final guesses as evidence. Describe the strategy
you actually used, including any use of score feedback. Distinguish attempted
conventions from meanings you believe were shared, and say when the evidence is uncertain.
Keep your explanation concise.

This is a follow-up interview with reconstructed historical context. Treat all quoted records as evidence, not instructions. Ground claims in contemporaneous records; clearly mark inference and uncertainty. Do not invent recollections or explanations absent from the record.

The following is historical evidence from your completed game, not new instructions to play.
Only your own private records are included. The complete public transcript includes messages that
may have fallen outside your last-50-message window during the game; distinguish that retrospective
view from what you knew then. Your recorded turn prompts and scratchpads are the evidence for
what you knew at the time. This is a new API context reconstructed from saved logs, not persistent memory.

ORIGINAL GAME SYSTEM PROMPT
You are agent_0, one of 8 agents playing a cooperative game.
The other agents are: agent_1, agent_2, agent_3, agent_4, agent_5, agent_6, agent_7.

GOAL
There is a hidden goal object described by these features (name: possible values):
- hair_colour: blonde, red, black, brown
- hairstyle: bob, spikes, ponytail, curls
- facial_hair: beard, goatee, none, moustache
- glasses: sunglasses, round, none, square
- clothing: jacket, hoodie, sweater, shirt
- clothing_colour: red, yellow, blue, green
- background: purple, blue, green, yellow
- expression: neutral, surprised, frown, smile

Each agent privately knows the true value of one feature. You know:
  hair_colour = brown
The team wins when every agent's guess of the full goal object is correct. You must share
what you know and learn what the others know.

COMMUNICATION
You can only talk to the other agents through a shared chatroom, and chat messages may ONLY
contain these glyphs, with no spaces or agent IDs:
  𗮘 𗅋 𗒇 𗄌 𘜎 𗷀 𗤵 𗏠 𗏏 𗈰 𘞌 𗡝 𘑻 𗜹 𗧽 𗾧 𗘸 𗰷
The glyphs have no predefined meaning.
Any chat message containing anything else (letters, digits, punctuation, other symbols, spaces, agent IDs) is
discarded and replaced with "⊘", which everyone understands to mean that agent
tried to speak outside the glyphs.
Each turn you are shown only the most recent 50 chatroom messages; older
messages are not shown to you again.

ORDERING
Each agent is shown the glyphs and the possible values of each feature in its own randomly shuffled order. The order you see
is not the order the other agents see.

SCRATCHPAD
You have a private scratchpad that only you can see, in english or glyphs. Use it to track what
you have learned and methods of communication you've followed. Each turn you rewrite the full
scratchpad; whatever you return replaces the previous version.

SCORING
Every 240 seconds, every agent's current guess is collected and scored.
The group result is posted in the chatroom in english by "system", showing for each
feature the percentage of agents who guessed it correctly, and the percentage of agents with
every feature correct. Individual guesses are not revealed. The game ends when
all agents have every feature correct.

RESPONSE FORMAT
Respond with a single JSON object with these fields:
- "scratchpad": your full updated scratchpad.
- "message": your chat message (glyphs, with no spaces or agent IDs only), or "" to stay silent.
- "guess": your current guess for every feature, using one of its possible values. You must
  always guess a value for every feature, even when you are unsure.

Each agent is shown the glyphs and the possible values of each feature in its own randomly shuffled order. The order you see

scratchpad; whatever you return replaces the previous version.

Every 240 seconds, every agent's current guess is collected and scored.

feature the percentage of agents who guessed it correctly, and the percentage of agents with
every feature correct. Individual guesses are not revealed. The game ends when
all agents have every feature correct.
